name: Adaptive Sparse Voxelization with Bounding Box Thickness Cases
definition: A triangle-to-voxel rasterization algorithm that classifies triangles into 9 cases based on the thickness of their axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) in grid coordinates to optimize overlap testing. It uses Morton codes for sparse voxel storage and supports both binary and data-rich (colored/normal) voxelization modes.
summary: Adaptive Sparse Voxelization with Bounding Box Thickness Cases rasterizes triangle meshes into sparse voxels by classifying bounding boxes into nine thickness-based cases to optimize overlap testing.
